title: ‘ ₹21,000 rent,  ₹10,000 on commuting’: Bengaluru woman's  ₹1 lakh monthly budget breakdown goes viral
content:
• Bengaluru-based woman Ishita Chaudhary shared a monthly expenditure of approximately ₹1 lakh, including ₹21,000 for rent for a 3BHK.
• Ishita Chaudhary's monthly budget breakdown in Bengaluru allocates ₹10,000 for city commuting and ₹20,000 for travelling and trips.
• Another Instagram user, Chahat Yadav, a 21-year-old living alone in Gurgaon, spent a total of ₹43,096 in July, with ₹15,000 covering rent for a fully furnished 1RK apartment.

title: North Korea launches ballistic missile toward sea, its second test in a week ahead of South Korea-US military drills
content:
• The joint military exercise between South Korea and the United States, named Ulchi Freedom Shield, is scheduled to commence on Monday, 17 August, and will last for 11 days.
• North Korea carried out a previous short-range ballistic missile test on 6 August, which was its first ballistic weapons testing activity since late June.
• North Korea's ballistic missile launches are in defiance of multiple UN Security Council resolutions that explicitly ban such activities.

title: RBI, Sebi bolster cyber shield for financial sector players
content:
• In fiscal year 2026 (FY26), banks and financial institutions reported 10,114 cases of fraud, with the total amount involved rising by 46.4% to ₹48,021 crore.
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rolled out "MuleHunter.AI" in 2024, an AI/ML-based solution, to curb the misuse of 'mule accounts' for diversion of funds in cyber frauds.
• The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) introduced the Market Security Operations Centre (M-SOC) in FY26, with NSE and BSE establishing M-SOCs in April 2025 and onboarding 376 market participants by 30 March 2026.

title: 68% report high treatment costs, 56% flag costly ICU, room charges in private hospitals: Survey
content:
• The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Health and Family Welfare tabled its 176th Report on “Affordability and Accessibility of Healthcare Facilities in Public and Private Sector” in Parliament on August 7, recommending standardisation and capping of treatment costs.
• The 80th round of the National Sample Survey for January-December 2025 indicated an average hospitalisation cost of ₹6,631 at government hospitals versus ₹50,508 at private hospitals, nearly eight times higher.
• Out-of-pocket expenditure accounted for 43.4% of total health expenditure in 2022-23, with a recommendation to reduce this figure below 30% via a legally binding framework to standardise rates.

title: West Bengal SIR: Supreme Court asks ECI for data on appeals against electoral roll deletions
content:
• On Tuesday, the Supreme Court directed the Election Commission of India (ECI) to furnish data on appeals disposed of by tribunals concerning electoral roll deletions during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise in West Bengal.
• The plea was filed by Congress leader Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury, seeking the establishment of Special Intensive Revision (SIR) tribunals at every block across West Bengal for quicker disposal of appeals against electoral roll deletions.
• The Supreme Court clarified that any challenge to the denial of social welfare benefits by the West Bengal government to individuals whose names were deleted from electoral rolls should be pursued before the Calcutta High Court.

title: Net direct tax collections jump 23% to  ₹8.11 trillion by 10 August
content:
• India's net direct tax collections rose 23.09% year-on-year to ₹8.11 trillion between 1 April and 10 August.
• The FY27 budget has pegged gross receipts from corporation tax and taxes on income at about ₹26.97 trillion, with gross direct tax collections reaching ₹9.55 trillion by 10 August, representing roughly 35% of this target.
• Securities transaction tax (STT) recorded the sharpest growth, rising 51.30% year-on-year to ₹33,823.74 crore from ₹22,354.31 crore.

title: Pakistan-Saudi-Turkey defence pact: India ‘examining implications’ on national security, says MEA
content:
• A trilateral defence pact was signed between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey in Mecca on August 7.
• A central provision of the pact states that an armed attack on any one of the three signatories would be treated as an act of aggression against all three.
• India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) is examining the implications of the pact on its national security and regional stability, as stated by spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal.

title: TikTok to mandate 5-day office work for US employees from September: Report
content:
• TikTok will mandate its US employees to work from the office five days a week starting in September.
• Employees in TikTok's TikTok Shop e-commerce division have been required to work from the office every day for more than a year.
• In December, TikTok reportedly told employees in departments including product, marketing, and advertising sales to prepare for a full return to the office in 2026.

title: India-SACU trade pact talks to begin by September, conclude within a year
content:
• India and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) will sign the Terms of Reference (ToR) on August 12 to formally begin negotiations for a preferential trade agreement (PTA).
• The Southern African Customs Union (SACU) consists of five member countries: Namibia, Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, and South Africa.
• During the fourth session of the India-Namibia Joint Trade Committee (JTC) in New Delhi, critical minerals such as lithium, graphite, copper, cobalt, and rare earth elements were identified as key areas for bilateral economic cooperation.

title: India's net direct tax collection rises 23% to Rs 8.11 lakh crore as of August 10
content:
• India's net direct tax collection increased by 23% to Rs 8.11 lakh crore as of August 10.
• Gross direct tax collections rose by 19.75% to Rs 9.55 lakh crore, while refunds issued stood at Rs 1.43 lakh crore, up 3.79% from the year-ago period.
• Net collections from the Securities Transaction Tax (STT) climbed to Rs 33,823.74 crore, compared with Rs 22,354.31 crore in the corresponding period last year.
